description:
DreamPlan Home Design Software is open on the Windows desktop showing the 'Contemporary House' sample project in 3D view. The project contains a fully designed house with multiple rooms including a kitchen with its current flooring.

Your task:
1. Navigate the 3D view to see the kitchen floor. Use the circular compass widget in the lower-left corner of the viewport to rotate the view, right-click and drag to orbit, scroll wheel to zoom, and double-click an area to enter it in first-person view.
2. Click on the kitchen floor to select it.
3. In the properties panel or right-click context menu, find the option to change the flooring material/texture.
4. Browse the available flooring materials and select 'Hardwood' or a wood-pattern flooring option.
5. Apply the new flooring material to the kitchen floor.
6. Verify the kitchen floor now shows the hardwood/wood texture.

Note: You may need to double-click or right-click the floor to access its properties. The flooring materials are organized by category (Wood, Tile, Carpet, Stone, etc.).
